summary: SUI Group Holdings filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Amended and Restated Digital Asset Loan Agreement with BlueFin Labs Inc. The registrant is loaning an additional 4 million SUI tokens (plus 2 million previously loaned) to finance BlueFin's acquisition of Suilend platform assets from Concurrent C. BlueFin will pay a revenue-based fee of 11% from itself and associated entities. The loan terminates September 2028. A related party, Karatage Opportunities (0.156% SEND token holder and 7.87% SUI stockholder), has an indirect interest. The independent board reviewed and approved the terms. This is a financing arrangement, not a direct M&A special situation.
